headline: Rosa Parks refuses to give up her seat
post_facts: Segregated city buses were struck down

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in nineteen fifty-five... Rosa Parks refused to give up her seat.

scenes.label: Rosa Parks
scenes.caption: Montgomery, Alabama
scenes.title: A seamstress heading home
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] She was a seamstress heading home in Montgomery, Alabama.

scenes.label: the Montgomery bus boycott
scenes.text: [solemnly] She was arrested, and a bus boycott began that lasted three hundred eighty-one days.

scenes.label: February 1956
scenes.caption: Parks fingerprinted during the boycott
scenes.title: Martin Luther King Jr. helped lead it
scenes.text: [calmly] A young pastor, Martin Luther King Junior, helped lead it.

scenes.title: Segregated buses struck down
scenes.text: [gently] Then the courts struck down segregated buses in Montgomery.
